# [TEST] - To Validate - CyberArk Monitoring

Two-page workbook: **CyberArk Show Password Monitoring** and **Password Change / Reset Monitoring**.

parameters.name: ExcludedSharedAccounts
parameters.label: 🚫 Shared accounts to exclude
parameters.query:
datatable(value:string, label:string)
[
    "__none__", "No exclusion"
]
| union (
    CommonSecurityLog
    | where TimeGenerated >= {TimeRange:start}
    | where DeviceVendor =~ "Cyber-Ark"
    | where DeviceProduct =~ "Vault"
    | where tostring(DeviceEventClassID) == "295"
    | extend ActorUser = tostring(SourceUserName)
    | extend EventType = case(
        ActorUser contains "PasswordManager"
            or ActorUser contains "NotificationEngine"
            or ActorUser contains "PSM"
            or ActorUser contains "PVWA"
            or ActorUser contains "AIM"
            or ActorUser contains "Provider"
            or ActorUser contains "AppProvider"
            or ActorUser contains "CyberarkAccountsIntegration",
            "CyberArk Component",
        ActorUser startswith "Prov_", "Application / Provider",
        isempty(ActorUser) or ActorUser == "-", "Unknown/System",
        "Human / Nominal User")
    | extend SharedAccount = tostring(DestinationUserName)
    | where EventType == "Human / Nominal User"
    | where isnotempty(SharedAccount) and SharedAccount !in~ ("Unknown", "-")
    | summarize Events = count() by SharedAccount
    | order by Events desc
    | project value = SharedAccount, label = strcat(SharedAccount, " - ", Events, " events")
)

## 🔐 CyberArk Show Password / Retrieve Password Monitoring
This page monitors Vault audit code `295` / `Retrieve Password`.

content.query:
let CyberArkPasswordRetrievals = CommonSecurityLog
| where TimeGenerated >= {TimeRange:start}
| where DeviceVendor =~ "Cyber-Ark"
| where DeviceProduct =~ "Vault"
| where tostring(DeviceEventClassID) == "295"
| extend ActorUser = tostring(SourceUserName)
| extend EventType = case(
    ActorUser contains "PasswordManager" or ActorUser contains "NotificationEngine" or ActorUser contains "PSM" or ActorUser contains "PVWA" or ActorUser contains "AIM" or ActorUser contains "Provider" or ActorUser contains "AppProvider" or ActorUser contains "CyberarkAccountsIntegration", "CyberArk Component",
    ActorUser startswith "Prov_", "Application / Provider",
    isempty(ActorUser) or ActorUser == "-", "Unknown/System",
    "Human / Nominal User")
| extend SharedAccount = tostring(DestinationUserName)
| extend Safe = tostring(DestinationUserPrivileges)
| extend AccountName = tostring(SourceUserName)
| extend SharedAccountLower = tolower(SharedAccount)
| extend SafeLower = tolower(Safe)
| extend SharedAccountCategory = case(
    SharedAccountLower contains "recon" or SharedAccountLower contains "pimgate" or SharedAccountLower contains "cyberarklogon", "Utenza automation / sistema",
    SafeLower contains "ut-general", "Utenza tecnica",
    isnotempty(SharedAccount) and SharedAccount !in~ ("Unknown", "-"), "Utenza privilegiata / Shared PIM",
    "Unknown / Not mapped")
| extend SharedAccountCategoryReason = case(
    SharedAccountLower contains "recon" or SharedAccountLower contains "pimgate" or SharedAccountLower contains "cyberarklogon", "Known automation/system account",
    SafeLower contains "ut-general", "Safe / Platform UT-General",
    isnotempty(SharedAccount) and SharedAccount !in~ ("Unknown", "-"), "Default privileged/shared PIM account",
    "Missing or unmapped shared account")
| extend ClientSource = case(isnotempty(tostring(SourceIP)), tostring(SourceIP), isnotempty(tostring(SourceHostName)), tostring(SourceHostName), isnotempty(tostring(DeviceAddress)), tostring(DeviceAddress), isnotempty(tostring(Computer)), tostring(Computer), "Unknown")
| extend SafeLabel = iff(strlen(Safe) > 38, strcat(substring(Safe, 0, 38), "..."), Safe)
| extend AccountSafeFullName = strcat(SharedAccount, " | ", Safe)
| extend AccountSafeLabel = strcat(iff(strlen(SharedAccount) > 30, strcat(substring(SharedAccount, 0, 30), "..."), SharedAccount), " | ", iff(strlen(Safe) > 25, strcat(substring(Safe, 0, 25), "..."), Safe));
CyberArkPasswordRetrievals
| summarize Events=count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1d), EventType
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Overall password retrieval trend by EventType

    SafeLower contains "ut-general", "Safe / Platform UT-General",
    isnotempty(SharedAccount) and SharedAccount !in~ ("Unknown", "-"), "Default privileged/shared PIM account",

| extend ClientSource = case(isnotempty(tostring(SourceIP)), tostring(SourceIP), isnotempty(tostring(SourceHostName)), tostring(SourceHostName), isnotempty(tostring(DeviceAddress)), tostring(DeviceAddress), isnotempty(tostring(Computer)), tostring(Computer), "Unknown")

| where EventType == "Human / Nominal User"
| where "__none__" in~ ({ExcludedSharedAccounts}) or SharedAccount !in~ ({ExcludedSharedAccounts});

(HumanEvents | summarize Value=dcount(ActorUser) | extend Metric="👤 Distinct human users", SortOrder=2),
(HumanEvents | summarize Value=dcount(Safe) | extend Metric="🗄️ Distinct safes", SortOrder=3),
(HumanEvents | summarize Value=dcount(SharedAccount) | extend Metric="🔑 Distinct accounts", SortOrder=4),
(HumanEvents | summarize Value=dcount(ClientSource) | extend Metric="🌐 Distinct client sources", SortOrder=5)
| order by SortOrder asc
| project Metric, Value

content.json:
## 🔐 CyberArk CPM password management errors
This section monitors CyberArk CPM password management failures, including `CPM Change Password Failed` on impacted shared accounts.

**Verify Password Failures (Code 2114) baseline** — validated against 30 days of production data: most `VerificationPeriod`-triggered failures trace back to CyberArk's own reconciliation actors (`recon`, `pimgate`, `cyberarklogon`) or bulk password-rotation waves, not external/unauthorized changes. Only `ImmediateTask`-triggered failures (real credential usage) warrant per-case investigation — see the Priority Baseline table below.

content.query:
let CyberArkCPMEvents =
CommonSecurityLog
| where TimeGenerated >= {TimeRange:start}
| where DeviceVendor =~ "Cyber-Ark"
| where DeviceProduct =~ "Vault"
| where tostring(DeviceEventClassID) in ("22", "24", "31", "38", "57", "60", "130")
| extend EventId = tostring(DeviceEventClassID)
| extend Safe = tostring(DestinationUserPrivileges)
| extend SharedAccount = tostring(DestinationUserName)
| extend ActorUser = tostring(SourceUserName)
| extend CPMOperation = case(
    EventId in ("24", "57"), "Change Password",
    EventId in ("22", "38"), "Verify Password",
    EventId in ("31", "60"), "Reconcile Password",
    EventId == "130", "Disable Password",
    "Other")
| extend CPMResult = case(
    EventId in ("22", "24", "31"), "Success",
    EventId in ("38", "57", "60", "130"), "Failure",
    "Unknown")
| extend CPMEventDescription = case(
    EventId == "24", "CPM Change Password",
    EventId == "57", "CPM Change Password Failed",
    EventId == "22", "CPM Verify Password",
    EventId == "38", "CPM Verify Password Failed",
    EventId == "31", "CPM Reconcile Password",
    EventId == "60", "CPM Reconcile Password Failed",
    EventId == "130", "CPM Disable Password Failed",
    Activity)
| extend ErrorText = strcat(tostring(Message), " ", tostring(Reason), " ", tostring(AdditionalExtensions), " ", tostring(DeviceCustomString1), " ", tostring(DeviceCustomString2), " ", tostring(DeviceCustomString3), " ", tostring(DeviceCustomString4), " ", tostring(DeviceCustomString5), " ", tostring(DeviceCustomString6));
let CyberArkCPMFailures = CyberArkCPMEvents
| where CPMResult == "Failure";
union
(CyberArkCPMFailures | summarize Value=count() | extend Metric="❌ CPM failure events", SortOrder=1),
(CyberArkCPMFailures | where EventId == "57" | summarize Value=count() | extend Metric="🔁 Change password failures", SortOrder=2),
(CyberArkCPMFailures | summarize Value=dcount(SharedAccount) | extend Metric="🔑 Impacted shared accounts", SortOrder=3),
(CyberArkCPMFailures | summarize Value=dcount(Safe) | extend Metric="🗄️ Impacted safes", SortOrder=4)
| order by SortOrder asc
| project Metric, Value
content.title: CyberArk CPM failure KPI summary

content.query:
CommonSecurityLog
| where TimeGenerated >= {TimeRange:start}
| where DeviceVendor =~ "Cyber-Ark"
| where DeviceProduct =~ "Vault"
| where tostring(DeviceEventClassID) == "38"
| extend Safe = tostring(DestinationUserPrivileges)
| extend SharedAccount = tostring(DestinationUserName)
| extend TriggerType = case(
    Message has "ImmediateTask", "ImmediateTask",
    Message has "VerificationPeriod", "VerificationPeriod",
    "Retry/Other")
| summarize
    FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated),
    LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated),
    Occurrences = count(),
    HasImmediateTask = countif(TriggerType == "ImmediateTask") > 0
    by DestinationHostName, SharedAccount, Safe
| extend Priority = case(
    HasImmediateTask, "ALTA - uso reale (ImmediateTask), verificare con owner applicativo/piattaforma",
    Occurrences == 1, "MEDIA - occorrenza isolata del job periodico, verificare se da rotazione CPM",
    "BASSA - pattern ricorrente, coerente con reconciliation loop CyberArk (recon/cyberarklogon/pimgate)")
| project DestinationHostName, SharedAccount, Safe, FirstSeen, LastSeen, Occurrences, Priority
| order by Priority asc, Occurrences desc
